name: Yuugao no Kimi
source:
The self-named cute leader of the five moonbeam wisemen.
He's from the house of the Minister of the Left and a relative of [url=/c53212]Aoi[/url].
He likes teasing people.
It's easy for him to be possessed by things not of this world.
